title: 24:4 earth mourneth and withereth away. The repetition of withereth, in conjunction with languisheth, emphasizes the earth's depleted and droughtlike condi- tion. With her strength gone, the earth is no longer able to bring forth fruit as she once had, a curse that has been associated with sin since the world's beginning (Gen. 3:17- 19). This in turn affects all who dwell on the earth—human beings, animals, and vegetables (24:7; 40:7-8; Hosea 4:3; JST Isa. 64:6). The earth mourns and withers both from judgment and from apostasy.
author: Tina M. Peterson
